finding.claim: The r1 test never stores feedback or a stored check, so the feedback count and the per-status counts are compared only in their trivial case (0 notes, every claim "no check"). A briefing that counted answered feedback, or always reported 0 notes, would pass.

fixes.change: A store rebuilt at each schema step 1 to 6 briefs with the same sections, claims and pending and an unchanged file (steps 1-4 fail on the old code); the counts test stores a holding check and a note, asserting holds, no check and 1 open note; the never-fails test checks --json prints an empty list and an unavailable key.
